# Policy as code + canary

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:policy-as-code` · **Epic:** [#183](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/183) · **Tickets:** 7 (2S 5M)

Policy can live in Git: the CP pulls YAML from a repo into drafts that go through the same replay and approval gates as console edits, and CI can lint and replay changes before merge. Approved versions can be rolled out to a canary subset of workers, watched, then promoted or rolled back.

## How we build it

- CP config `gitops: {repo, branch, path, interval: 60s, auth: {sshKeySecret|tokenSecret}, mode: advisory|authoritative}` using go-git (pure Go) pull only; CP never pushes. In authoritative mode console edits to policy are disabled.
- New commit -> parse files under `path` with the normal config loader + validation -> create a draft with provenance {source: git, commit, author, message}; drafts then run replay via `policyeval.Evaluate` and the Phase 2 approval gate unchanged.
- CLI for CI: `warden policy lint <file>` (strict YAML parse + validation, non-zero exit) and `warden policy replay --candidate f --cp-url --api-key-env` (remote replay against fleet events; `--fail-on-new-allows`).
- Canary: `rollouts` table {id, version, targets (worker ids or percent), status canary|promoted|rolled_back, started_at}. `ServePolicy` picks the version per worker identity (mTLS SAN worker id), ETag per version.
- Status from heartbeats (`policyETag` already reported) plus canary vs stable deny rate and error rate from the fleet store; promote sets current version for all; rollback returns canary workers to stable.

## Done when

A merged policy PR appears as a draft with replay results, is approved, rolled out to a canary worker, and promoted or rolled back from the console with status visible per worker.

### 1/7 · W-P4-GOPS-01

**Add warden policy lint and remote replay for CI**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#184](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/184)

Add `lint` and `replay` subcommands under `policyCmd` in cmd/proxy. `lint` parses with the strict config loader (KnownFields) and runs validation; `replay` posts the candidate to CP `POST /api/policy/replay` with an API key (`policy:read`) and prints NewAllows/NewDenies, exiting 1 with `--fail-on-new-allows` when security regressions exist. Keep existing `eval` for local SQLite.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Lint exits non-zero on unknown keys and invalid regex
- [ ] Replay exits 1 when NewAllows is non-empty and the flag is set
- [ ] Both commands produce machine-readable output with --json

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-AMCP-04`](admin-mcp.md#46--w-p4-amcp-04) Implement suggest_policy and replay_policy tools

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-GOPS-07`](policy-as-code.md#77--w-p4-gops-07) Document GitOps workflow with a GitHub Actions example

### 2/7 · W-P4-GOPS-02

**Add Git sync of policy into drafts**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#185](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/185)

Create new package internal/gitsync using go-git to clone/fetch `gitops.repo` at `branch` every `interval`; credentials come from the secret backend by reference, never stored in CP state. On a new commit, load YAML under `path`, validate, and create a draft with provenance {commit, author, message}; invalid content records a sync error and creates no draft. Expose `GET /api/gitops/status` (last commit, last sync, last error).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] New commit creates exactly one draft
- [ ] Invalid YAML records an error and no draft
- [ ] Same commit is not re-imported after restart

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-GOPS-03`](policy-as-code.md#37--w-p4-gops-03) Gate Git drafts through replay and approvals

### 3/7 · W-P4-GOPS-03

**Gate Git drafts through replay and approvals**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#186](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/186)

Run replay automatically on git drafts and attach the result; send them through the Phase 2 approval flow with the commit link shown. In `mode: authoritative`, block policy writes from the dashboard and API (409 with a pointer to the repo); in advisory mode show a drift banner when the served version differs from the repo head.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Git draft shows replay results before approval
- [ ] Authoritative mode returns 409 on console policy edits
- [ ] Drift banner appears in advisory mode

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-GOPS-02`](policy-as-code.md#27--w-p4-gops-02) Add Git sync of policy into drafts

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-GOPS-04`](policy-as-code.md#47--w-p4-gops-04) Add canary rollout model and per-worker policy serving

### 4/7 · W-P4-GOPS-04

**Add canary rollout model and per-worker policy serving**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#187](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/187)

Add a `rollouts` table and `RolloutStore` in internal/controlplane. Change the policy server so `ServePolicy` resolves the worker id from the client cert SAN and returns the canary version's bundle to targeted workers and the stable version to others, each with its own ETag; percent targets use a stable hash of worker id. Only one active rollout at a time.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Targeted worker receives the canary version, others stable
- [ ] Percent targeting is stable across restarts
- [ ] Starting a second rollout while one is active returns 409

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-GOPS-03`](policy-as-code.md#37--w-p4-gops-03) Gate Git drafts through replay and approvals

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-GOPS-05`](policy-as-code.md#57--w-p4-gops-05) Add promote, rollback and rollout status APIs

### 5/7 · W-P4-GOPS-05

**Add promote, rollback and rollout status APIs**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#188](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/188)

Add `POST /api/rollouts/{id}/promote` (sets current version for all workers) and `/rollback` (canary workers return to stable). `GET /api/rollouts/{id}` returns per-worker applied version from heartbeat `policyETag` plus canary vs stable deny rate and error rate over the rollout window from the fleet store. Both actions need the admin role and are audited.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Promote moves all workers to the canary version within one long-poll
- [ ] Rollback moves canary workers back to stable
- [ ] Status shows which workers have applied which version

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-GOPS-04`](policy-as-code.md#47--w-p4-gops-04) Add canary rollout model and per-worker policy serving
